source.author: stat
source.text: quae laeta sub isto igne poli non quaeris aquas, succurre propinquis gentibus: Arquitenens seu te Latonia casto de grege transmisit thalamis, seu lapsus ab astris non humilis fecundat amor neque enim ipse deorum arbiter Argolidum thalamis novus .
source.text_original: quae laeta sub isto / igne poli non quaeris aquas, succurre propinquis / gentibus: Arquitenens seu te Latonia casto / de grege transmisit thalamis, seu lapsus ab astris / non humilis fecundat amor — neque enim ipse deorum / arbiter Argolidum thalamis novus — .
source.text_english: You, who gladly beneath that fire of the sky do not seek the waters, come to the aid of the neighboring nations: Arquitenens, whether Latonia sent you from her chaste flock to the bridal chamber, or whether fallen from the stars, some no lowly love makes fruitful—for indeed the ruler of the gods himself is no stranger to the Argolic bridal chambers.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: arbiter ipse locos terrenaque summa movendo experiar, quaenam populis longissima cunctis regna velim linquamque datas ubi certus habenas.
reuse.text_original: arbiter ipse locos terrenaque summa movendo / experiar, quaenam populis longissima cunctis / regna velim linquamque datas ubi certus habenas.
reuse.text_english: I myself will try out the sites and the highest things of the earth by setting them in motion, so as to see which kingdoms I would want longest for all peoples, and where, once I am certain, I shall leave the reins that have been given me.
